change.note: (1) /spike returns notFound() unless NODE_ENV=development or server-side SPIKE_ENABLED=1 (src/lib/spike.ts spikeEnabled; force-dynamic so the flag is read per request). (2) When reachable, the cdn is resolved on the server from the SPIKE_CDN_ORIGINS allow-list (default http://localhost:3141); ?cdn= only selects an entry, and the string used is always the allow-list entry, so nothing from the query string becomes a frame, fetch or script source. Manifest frame paths go through frameUrlOn and are refused if they leave that origin (@host, //host). SpikeHost no longer reads ?cdn= or NEXT_PUBLIC_SPIKE_CDN. (3) Spike progress writes go to s3c:spike:progress:v1, never the learner key; spike frame events are no longer forwarded to /api/events. (4) /api/events returns 403 for Origin: null (sandboxed frames), any other Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site/cross-origin, a foreign Referer or a /spike Referer; same-host requests (incl. Host/X-Forwarded-Host behind a proxy) and Origin-less requests still 204. Progress has no server API (localStorage only). (5) Spike harness config sets SPIKE_ENABLED=1 for next start. Evidence: npm run test:spike 5/5 (prod guard, allow-list, frame paths, event intake both ways); tsc --noEmit -p . exit 0; npm run check passed; dev :3530 /spike?cdn=https://example.com -> 200 with cdn resolved to http://localhost:3141 (example.com only in Next router URL echo); ?cdn=http://localhost:3141@example.com -> same; POST /api/events with Origin: null -> 403, with /spike Referer -> 403, same-origin /d/ lesson -> 204. Not done: next build / prod run (machine overloaded, told not to), live site not checked. Reviewer questions: is the Origin-less pass acceptable; is 403 vs silent 204 right for the analytics steward; should the route leave the app build entirely at stage 1.
